newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia business confidence stalled - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Australia business confidence stalled - Treasury.

text.p: Australian Treasury secretary Ted Evans said on Monday business confidence was unlikely to improve until employment levels lifted.
"It's not yet reflecting the fact that growth has picked up in calendar 1997, but we're yet to see that in the labour market," Evans told a parliamentary committee.
"I suspect until we do see it in the labour market, we won't see a change in confidence."
Australia's unemployment rate has been stuck at or above 8.5 percent since the Liberal-National coalition won office in March 1996.
Unemployment rose to 8.7 percent in July from 8.5 percent a month earlier.
